title: Switch default sound output to headphones or HDMI
summary: Sound plays from whichever output device is the default. Find the headphones or HDMI output in the list of outputs, then make it the default so new sound goes there.

aliases.text: sound plays on wrong device linux
send sound to hdmi monitor linux
звук идёт не в наушники linux
отправить звук на hdmi монитор linux

prerequisites: Headphones or the HDMI monitor or TV are plugged in and switched on
PipeWire with WirePlumber (wpctl), or PulseAudio (pactl). Packages: wireplumber; pulseaudio-utils (libpulse on Arch)

steps.explain: List the output devices (sinks) and see which one is the current default. In the Sinks section, the line with * is the default. The number before the dot is the device ID.
steps.expect: Under 'Sinks:' lines look like '│  *   44. TestOutput  [vol: 1.00]'. The * marks the current default.

alternatives.explain: Same list for PulseAudio systems or when wpctl is not installed. The name in the second column is what the pactl alternative in the next step needs.

steps.explain: Make the device you want the default. Replace <SINK_ID> with the number from the Sinks list, for example 44. Do not type the placeholder literally.

placeholders.name: SINK_ID
placeholders.description: Number before the dot of the headphones or HDMI device in the Sinks list

steps.expect: No message when it works. Check with the verify commands below.

alternatives.explain: PulseAudio way, also works on PipeWire systems. Replace <SINK_NAME> with the name from the second column of pactl list short sinks, not the number.

placeholders.name: SINK_NAME
placeholders.description: Name in the second column of the device list, for example test_out

verify.expect: The line of the device you chose now starts with * under Sinks.
The Default Sink line shows the name of the device you chose.

warnings: HDMI devices appear in the list only while a monitor or TV is connected and on. If the device you need is missing, check the cable or see the pipewire-switch-profile card.
Programs that are already playing sound may keep using the old device. Restart the program or change its output in its own settings.
